items.title: 9.2.2 Key Parts of a Business Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the parts of a business plan (PDF 210-211).

blocks.caption: Business plan ke aham hisse
rows: Executive summary
mukhtasar jaiza: karobar kya karta, maqasid aur tareeqa
mukhtasar aham nukte
Business description
products ya services, gahak, kya munfarid hai
bazaar ke qareeb taza chai wala chai dhaba
Market analysis
gahak, un ki zarooratein aur muqabil
qareeb ke pet owners aur doosri pet-sitting services
Organization aur management
karobar ka dhancha; team aur zimmedariyan
school club ka president aur secretary
Products ya services
khoobiyan aur faide
tuition se grades kaise behtar hon
Marketing aur sales strategy
gahak kaise layein aur rakhein
social media aur maqami melon se craft karobar
Financial plan
budget, funding ki zaroorat aur mutawaqqo aamdani
saaman ke liye paise kaise jama hon aur kya kamaye

blocks.alt: Baen: chakkar mein paanch dabbe, Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype aur Test, har ek school bag ki misal ke saath, aur Test se wapas Empathize tak surkh teer. Daen: business plan ke hisson ke saat dabbe chhote notes ke saath. Neeche: juice ki dukaan ki misal se pitch ke paanch qadam, masla, hal, munfarid nukta, sameen aur sawalat.
blocks.caption: Design thinking, business plan aur pitch (topics 9.1 se 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Design thinking users se hamdardi se shuru hoti hai, jaise students se un ke bags ke baare mein poochna, phir masla tay karti hai (halka, mazboot, kushada bag), hal sochti hai (padding, jebein), jaldi namoona banati hai (gatte ka model) aur users se aazmati hai; un ka feedback wapas ja kar design behtar karta hai. Business plan mein executive summary, business description, market analysis, organization aur management, products ya services, marketing aur sales, aur financial plan hote hain. Pitch masla, hal, munfarid baat aur kis ke liye hai batati aur sawalat ki tayyari karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: school bake sale jaise saade khayal ka in hisson (aur zaroorat ho to appendix) se business plan likh kar share karein aur raye dein. Aham qadam bataiye (short question 3) aur har ek kyun zaroori hai, samjhaiye (long question 2).
blocks.explanation: Qadam: khayal tay kar ke khulasa; karobar ka bayan; market ka tajziya; team; products ki tafseel; marketing aur sales ka mansooba; financial plan. Har ek ahem hai: khulasa parhne walon ko jaldi qail karta; bayan aur products peshkash wazeh karte; market analysis asal talab aur muqabil dikhata; team batati hai kaam kaun karega; marketing batati hai gahak kaise milenge; aur financial plan dikhata hai ke karobar apna kharcha utha sakta hai ya nahi aur kitna paisa chahiye.

items: Saat hisse: summary, description, market, organization, products, marketing aur sales, finance.
